positive.prompt: We found suspicious browser token handling and a scanner warning. Diagnose whether there is an actual application security flaw.
Review our SPA and supporting API against OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 Level 2, indicating untested backend controls.
Implement a targeted fix for a confirmed session management weakness without changing unrelated authentication flows.
Validate the security remediation and reconcile manual evidence, SAST and ASVS requirement coverage.
Users remain authenticated after logout and a refresh token may be reused. Investigate and propose an authorized fix.
A user from tenant A can request tenant B records by changing the object identifier. Diagnose authorization.
Our React view renders CMS-controlled HTML into an unsafe sink. Review the injection boundary.
We want to inspect a CSP and third-party script policy after adding a new analytics widget.
A GraphQL subscription may deliver another user’s record and the upload form accepts large files.
Sensitive fields are cached in the browser and the application uses a custom encryption helper.
A client bundle accidentally contains an API credential from a build environment variable.
A CI dependency audit found a vulnerable indirect package. Evaluate provenance and remediation.
Our API error responses show a stack trace and our audit log might include session identifiers.
Design a threat model for a multi-tenant SaaS dashboard and its API and identity boundaries.

negative.prompt: Update a marketing headline, without changing any application code.
Audit WCAG 2.2 keyboard focus and screen-reader labels only.
negative.expected_behavior: Route to wcag-* unless a real security risk is observed.
